topic_label: Commitment to integrity and ethical values
control_description: Code of conduct in the employee handbook, acknowledged at hire and annually; sanctions statement in POL-01 4.7

No board (privately held LLC). The Chief Executive Officer (majority owner) approves the security budget, policies, and High risks; quarterly security review with the CTO and IT Manager started 2026-09-22
gap: Only one oversight meeting on record; the auditor will need quarterly minutes through the period
remediation: Hold and minute quarterly security reviews (next 2026-12-15)

control_description: Roles and reporting lines set in POL-01 section 3 and the org chart; security and privacy leads designated in writing
Background checks before hire; annual awareness training; semiannual phishing simulations
gap: No secure coding training for the 21 engineers
remediation: Annual secure coding course (POAM-019)

control_description: Policy owners named in each policy; POA&M owners named; sanctions statement
gap: New policies not yet acknowledged by staff
remediation: Collect POL-05 acknowledgments from all 60 staff

control_description: Infrastructure inventory from code and the provider's inventory service; device inventory from device management
gap: Data inventory does not cover staging, logs, or AI prompts; 4 corporate SaaS apps missing from inventory
remediation: Data inventory and data-use register (POL-04 4.4); add the 4 apps

topic_label: Internal communication of objectives and responsibilities
control_description: Policies published on the intranet; security channel; onboarding covers security duties
gap: Policies approved 2026-09-22; acknowledgment and procedure rollout still in progress
remediation: Acknowledgments and procedure walkthroughs for engineering and support

control_description: Security page, DPA, public sub-processor list, status page, and questionnaire answers communicate commitments to customers
evidence: Security page capture; DPA; status page history
gap: Security page claims every access is logged (not true for the break-glass role); AI model provider added with 12 days' notice instead of 30; unsupported 'fair and unbiased' AI claim; no per-customer security contact list
remediation: Correct the page and AI claim; re-notice customers; quarterly statement review (POL-01 4.10); contact list (POAM-016)

topic_label: Objectives specified to enable risk identification
control_description: Service commitments and system requirements described in the Type 1 system description (Security and Confidentiality)
gap: System description does not yet cover Availability commitments (99.9% SLA, RTO and RPO) or the AI assistant
remediation: Update the system description for the Type 2 scope

control_description: Annual NIST SP 800-30 risk assessment covering the WSP, staging, sub-processors, and the AI assistant
Insider misuse is covered by R-002 and R-008
gap: No explicit fraud risk assessment, for example altering pay rates or time punches, or misuse of view-as-tenant for personal gain
remediation: Add fraud scenarios to the risk register and review payroll export integrity controls (R-016)

control_description: POL-01 4.3 requires a risk assessment before major changes
gap: The AI assistant and model provider went live in 2026 without a change risk assessment
remediation: Change risk checklist in design review; first use on AI general availability (P10)

control_description: Independent control assessment (P07, 2026-08-31 to 2026-09-04); SOC 2 Type 1
gap: No ongoing monitoring between assessments
remediation: Monthly evidence checks against the evidence calendar (section 5 of the summary)

control_description: Weaknesses tracked in the POA&M with owners and dates; reviewed monthly by the CTO

topic_label: Control activities selected to mitigate risk
control_description: Controls selected from the Moderate baseline and P01 treatments
General IT controls defined in the SSP for identity, change, operations, and infrastructure
gap: Key technology controls are defined but not yet operating (privileged access, monitoring)
remediation: Close the readiness gates in section 3.2 of the summary

topic_label: Control activities deployed through policies and procedures
control_description: POL-01 to POL-05 approved 2026-09-22
gap: Procedures for access reviews, log reviews, and sub-processor reviews are not yet written
remediation: Write the 3 procedures with checklists

topic_label: Logical access security software, infrastructure, architecture
control_description: Single sign-on with MFA for all workforce; hardware keys for production; encryption at rest and in transit; tenant isolation in the application
evidence: IdP policy; encryption settings; isolation tests
gap: Type 1 exception 1: shared break-glass database role; long-lived static CI keys; tenant isolation has one layer
remediation: Named just-in-time access with session recording (POAM-001, POAM-003); federated CI credentials (POAM-005); row security (POAM-009, due 2027-01-31, in-period change)

control_description: Accounts created from People Operations tickets and approved by the system owner
gap: 2 former contractors kept local repository accounts outside single sign-on (removed 2026-09-04)
remediation: SSO-only membership on all systems; contractor end dates in tickets (POAM-001)

control_description: Role-based access; engineers read-only by default; access disabled on the last day
gap: Break-glass role for routine fixes; quarterly reviews cover only the identity provider; all engineers can write to staging; view-as-tenant without customer approval
remediation: Quarterly reviews of all systems; staging access reduced; ticket-linked, customer-approved view-as-tenant (POAM-001, POAM-002, R-008)

control_description: No production systems in the office; data center physical security inherited from the cloud provider
Laptops wiped through device management before reuse; certified recycler with certificates; provider sanitizes cloud media

topic_label: Protection against threats from outside boundaries
control_description: Only the load balancer and web application firewall face the internet; private subnets; no inbound shell access; provider DDoS protection

topic_label: Restriction of data transmission and movement
control_description: TLS 1.2 or higher; payroll exports through expiring signed links
gap: Type 1 exception 2 recurs: unmasked production data moved to staging monthly; worker names sent to the model provider
remediation: Stop refreshes and purge (POAM-010); remove names from prompts (P10)

topic_label: Prevention and detection of unauthorized or malicious software
control_description: EDR on all laptops; containers built only from scanned base images by CI
gap: CI actions and base images not pinned by digest; images not signed (R-014)
remediation: Pin by digest and sign release images

topic_label: Detection of configuration changes and vulnerabilities
control_description: Dependency and image scanning; infrastructure as code
gap: Scan findings not enforced and no remediation timelines; no alert for risky configuration changes; 3 buckets and 2 queue policies configured by hand
remediation: Deploy gate and timelines (POAM-017); configuration monitoring; bring buckets into code

topic_label: Monitoring for anomalies and security events
control_description: Uptime and error monitoring with on-call alerts; EDR alerts
gap: No threat detection; no alerts on unusual API use, bulk reads, or snapshot copies; no log review; 90-day log retention
remediation: Threat detection on by 2026-10-16 (gate); weekly privileged review from 2026-11-02; object logging and 1-year archive (POAM-004, POAM-006 to POAM-008)

control_description: On-call engineer and IT Manager triage security events
gap: No severity scheme or monthly review until POL-03 (approved 2026-09-22)
remediation: Apply POL-03 severity scheme; monthly incident review

control_description: Incident plan (Type 1) and the P08 runbook for cloud credential compromise; notification matrix
gap: Plan never tested; no forensic retainer; no customer security contact list
remediation: Tabletop 2026-11-18; retainer; contact list (POAM-015, POAM-016)

control_description: Production can be rebuilt from code and images
gap: No DR plan or recovery runbook; no lessons-learned records
remediation: DR plan (POAM-012, in-period change); lessons-learned template (POAM-015)

control_description: Pull requests with one reviewer and passing tests; infrastructure as code
evidence: Pull request sample; branch protection settings
gap: Administrator bypass of branch protection (3 in 90 days); no security and privacy impact step; unmasked production data in staging
remediation: Remove bypass (2026-10-15); design review step (POAM-020); staging purge (POAM-010)

control_description: BIA approved 2026-09-22; cyber insurance; offline punch queues in the mobile and kiosk apps
gap: No DR plan; restore took 5 hours against a 2-hour RTO
remediation: DR plan and recovery tests (POAM-012, POAM-013)

topic_label: Vendor and business partner risk management
control_description: DPAs with 5 of 6 sub-processors; public sub-processor list
gap: Type 1 exception 3 recurs: no security review before onboarding and no annual SOC 2 review; model provider has no DPA
remediation: Tiered review program and first annual reviews (vendor-soc2-review.csv); model provider DPA (POAM-011)

control_description: Container autoscaling; database and queue performance monitoring; status page
gap: No documented capacity review or thresholds
remediation: Quarterly capacity review with thresholds for database, queue, and shift-change peaks

control_description: Point-in-time recovery (7 days); daily snapshots copied to a second region; provider-managed facilities
gap: Backups can be deleted with production; daily regional copies give a 24-hour regional RPO against a 15-minute BIA RPO; restore took 5 hours
remediation: Separate backup account with write-once retention (POAM-014); regional RPO decision in the DR plan

control_description: One database restore test (January 2026)
gap: No DR plan to test; no failover test; restore missed the 2-hour RTO
remediation: Semiannual restore and failover tests (POAM-013, in-period change)

topic_label: Identification and maintenance of confidential information
control_description: POL-04 classifies customer worker data as Restricted; encryption; tenant isolation
gap: Type 1 exception 2: confidential customer data copied to staging; names sent to the model provider; data inventory incomplete
remediation: Purge staging (POAM-010); minimum data to the model provider; data inventory

control_description: DPA promises deletion within 90 days after termination
gap: 14 former customers' tenants never deleted; payroll exports kept since 2022
remediation: Delete tenants; automated deletion with evidence; lifecycle rule (POAM-018)
